newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi lifts Sept Arab Light crude formula to Asia.
newsitem.headline: Saudi lifts Sept Arab Light crude formula to Asia.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has said it will raise its September-lifting crude oil price formula to Asian customers by 10 cents per barrel for both Arab Light and Berri Extra Light, traders said on Tuesday.
Saudi Arabia has also told its Asian customers that it will raise its September-lifting crude oil price formula for Arab Medium and Arab Heavy by 20 cents per barrel, they said.
The September term crude price for Arab Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus 10 cents per barrel, traders said.
